$comment: Which DeepSeek Harness build the desktop client wraps.
npm    - npm install the published @deepseek-ai/dsh at 'npm.version' (no image bridge)
source - pnpm build + pnpm deploy a harness checkout (includes the image bridge)
'source.repoRoot' is relative to this repo; CI checks the fork out there before
a source build. 'source.repo'/'source.ref' record what CI clones.
'node.range' picks the Node.js major bundled next to the harness.
